integrity: The proof is analytic with supplementary reproducibility checks. Earlier forward contamination models are cited; originality is provisional on inspected evidence.
scientific_limitations: Exact noise-free monochromatic data, not finite filters
Single constant-temperature cool spot with fixed coverage; no faculae or limb darkening
Known photosphere temperature and achromatic intrinsic planet depth
Physical area constraint on planet and no independent field validation
scientific_scope: Exact inverse identifiability under three monochromatic Planck channels with harmonic wavelengths and one unocculted cool-blackbody component; achromatic transit and known photosphere temperature.
title: Three-channel Planck inversion of cool-starspot transit contamination
